newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share turnover leaps, Staburadze leads.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share turnover leaps, Staburadze leads.

text.p: Latvian share trade leapt on Thursday, led by healthy activity in leading confectionary maker, Staburadze.
Total turnover came to 214,034 lats versus Wednesday's 59,738 lats and Staburadze traded 84,237 lats as it rose 15 percent to 2.30 lats.
The other two official list shares were also well-traded, with usual market leader bank Unibanka trading 36,302 lats and closed at 2.50 lats, a rise of eight santimes.
Riga Transport Fleet turned over 21,140 lats and rose by one santime to one lat.
The secondary market was led by Salacgriva fish cannery, which saw a further rise in activity, reaching a high 31,625 lats but was stable at 2.30 lats.
Riga Yeast factory was also up on 21,070 lats turnover and the price was unchanged at 3.01 lats.
Daugavpils Chain maker gained to 1.16 from 1.15 traded 9,024 lats while the Jekabpils Sugar factory turned over 6,757 lats and fell to 29 santines from 34 santimes.
Lode Brick factory saw business of 1,253 lats of shares and climbed to 1.11 lats against 1.05 lats.
